jobs.detail: LEVER BICEP CURL, seated leverage biceps machine with upright BACKREST. Side-front three-quarter view, person faces IMAGE LEFT. Seat pelvis and back supported, feet flat shoulder width. Machine has compact steel base, two linked curl lever arms with fixed pivot axis aligned to user's ELBOWS, paired short horizontal handles held with UNDERHAND SUPINATED grip (palms up), weight-stack/cam linkage visible and connected. NO preacher pad forcing arms in front; elbows remain CLOSE to torso sides with shoulders relaxed and upper arms nearly vertical and SAME positions both panels. LEFT elbows nearly fully extended soft, forearms reach down/forward holding handles low near thighs. RIGHT flex elbows to curl handles up toward shoulders, forearms rotate upward while elbows/upper arms stay fixed; wrists neutral and palms up, no shoulder raise or torso lean. Handles follow fixed-radius lever arc connected to same machine pivot; exactly two hands/two handles, closed fingers around grips. RED PRIMARY BICEPS exposed on BOTH upper arms only; forearm/triceps/deltoid gray; shirt/shorts solidblack, no chest tint.

jobs.detail: LEVER CHEST PRESS on seated horizontal chest-press machine. Same SIDE-front three-quarter view person faces IMAGE LEFT. Seat hips and upper back against slightly inclined upright BACKREST, feet flat shoulder width. Full steel leverage machine with two pressing arms pivoting above/behind shoulders, horizontal handles at MID-CHEST level, connected resistance/weight stack, stable complete base. LEFT both hands securely grasp horizontal handles OVERHAND (palms downward), elbows bent about90degrees and 45-60degrees out from torso, wrists neutral in line with forearms, handles beside chest. RIGHT extend BOTH elbows to press handles straight FORWARD away from chest to almost-straight arms at same mid-chest height, same overhand grip, back/pelvis stay pressed against pad; no torso lift, no overhead press. Machine lever arms swing on SAME fixed pivots, no detached handles/changed arm length or apparatus. Primary PECTORALS only a very faint smooth BLURRY red surface print ON intact BLACK chest fabric with cloth wrinkles crossing tint, NO anatomical pectoral fibers/segments or cutaway, abdomen solidblack. All exposed limb muscles grayscale. Whole machine and full hands/shoes framed in own panel.
